description: Implementation of a GLX Pbuffer surface for EGL in the ANGLE project, managing creation, resizing, and lifecycle of Pbuffers on the GLX platform.

classes.name: rx::PbufferSurfaceGLX
classes.description: Class managing a GLX Pbuffer surface for EGL, including creation, resizing, and context binding.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the Pbuffer surface, creating a native GLX Pbuffer with specified dimensions and properties.

methods.name: makeCurrent
methods.description: Makes the Pbuffer surface current in the given GL context.

methods.name: swap
methods.description: Swaps buffers if applicable (no-op for Pbuffer).

methods.name: postSubBuffer
methods.description: Posts a sub-region of the surface (no-op).

methods.name: bindTexImage
methods.description: Binds the surface as a texture image (unimplemented).

methods.name: releaseTexImage
methods.description: Releases the surface from being a texture image (unimplemented).

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the Pbuffer.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the Pbuffer.

methods.name: isPostSubBufferSupported
methods.description: Indicates if post sub-buffer is supported (unimplemented).

methods.name: checkForResize
methods.description: Checks if resize is needed; always returns success as size doesn't change.
